# Proofloom source reference

Repository: https://github.com/img2vid/proofloom

Pinned commit: 2fa2d34a2a50fd1a62f9c08c0d9a071265449518

Retrieved using the connected GitHub plugin on 2026-10-31.

These unmodified MIT-licensed files document the behaviors ported/adapted in
`openvoice/spelling.py`, `openvoice/ocr_ui.py`, and the PDF import strategy. The
desktop application executes Python rather than these reference JS files. The
upstream license is preserved here and in application resources. English dialect
pairs were extracted into `openvoice/resources/english_variants.txt`.

See `OCR_AND_SPELLING.md` for the file-by-file implementation mapping.
